name: NAVA
description: NAVA (Native Audio-Visual Alignment for Generation) is a 6.3-billion parameter multimodal diffusion model developed by Baidu ERNIE Research. Utilizing an Align-then-Fuse MMDiT architecture, NAVA generates temporally synchronized and semantically coherent 720p video and stereo audio natively in a single unified pass.
keyFeatures: Align-then-Fuse MMDiT Architecture: Establishes fine-grained audio-video correspondence in a dedicated alignment space before joint denoising
Timbre-in-Context Conditioning: Binds reference WAV audio files to text speech spans for precise multi-speaker voice identity control
Native Audio-Visual Synchronization: Simultaneously synthesizes 720p video and stereo audio without post-hoc vocoders or visual lip-sync models
Camera & Motion Control: Supports language-described camera movement, pacing, composition, and flexible aspect ratios
High Computational Efficiency: Synthesizes fully synchronized audio-video content in ~1 minute on an 8-GPU setup
curatorNotes: Verified open-source research model from Baidu ERNIE Research. Paper published on arXiv (2605.30073), GitHub repository under ernie-research/NAVA, and model weights on Hugging Face.
